section: Important things you should keep in mind about these benefits:
headers: You pay After the calendar year deductible…

rows.Benefits Description: Deductible before Traditional medical coverage begins

The deductible applies to almost all benefits in this Section. In the You pay column, we say 'no deductible' when it does not apply. When you receive covered services, you are responsible for paying the allowable charges until you meet the deductible.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: 100% of allowable charges until you meet the deductible of $1,800 for Self Only enrollment or $3,600 for a Self Plus One enrollment or a Self and Family enrollment when you use in-network providers. 100% of allowable charges until you meet the deductible of $4,500 for Self Only enrollment or $9,000 for a Self Plus One enrollment or a Self and Family enrollment when you use out- of-network providers. Only plan allowance paid for services or supplies from out-of-network providers counts towards this amount.

rows.Benefits Description: After you meet the deductible, we pay the allowable charge (less your coinsurance) until you meet the annual catastrophic out-of-pocket maximum.
rows.You pay After the calendar year deductib: In-network: After you meet the deductible, you pay the indicated coinsurance for covered services. You may choose to pay the coinsurance from your HSA or HRA, or you can pay for them out-of-pocket. If you have an HRA, we will withdraw the amount from your HRA if funds are available. Out-of-network: After you meet the deductible, you pay the indicated coinsurance based on our Plan allowance and any difference between our allowance and the billed amount.
